checks.what: colonial-brazil gains the Misiones Orientales (Jesuit Missions inside Brazil, 235 cells, about 59,000 km2, NW Rio Grande do Sul) from portuguese-empire, Oct 1801. The page lists the 'Portuguese invasion of Misiones Orientales' among the results of the war of 20 May-9 June 1801, has Badajoz accepted 6 June and Madrid signed 29 September 1801, and says the Eastern Missions were never given back; the Misiones Orientales page says 'definitively ceded to Portugal in the Treaty of Badajoz (1801)'. The transfer from metropole to colony is bookkeeping (month 10 is after the Madrid treaty). Trial: the 235 cells are Spanish at the end of 1800 and colonial-brazil's (Portuguese vassal tint) from the end of 1801 to 1810; before the patch 226 were ownerless.

kingdom-of-sardinia_1800 now ends in 1801 (correction unchanged). The page: the republic 'ceased to exist on 11 September 1802', divided between France (Doire, Marengo, Po, Sesia, Stura, Tanaro) and the Italian Republic (Novara as Agogna); Charles Emmanuel abdicated 4 June 1802. Shape 213 cells (about 53,900 km2: Piedmont, Aosta, the island). Trial: Piedmont-Aosta without Novara (109 cells) French 99 / Italian Republic 10 from the end of 1802 to 1810 (published draft: Sardinian 97); the island stays Sardinian; ledger/26 returns Piedmont in 1814, so later years are not broken.

french-consulate_1800 (Cliopatria 1800 with Egypt, plus the Jura; correction unchanged) now ends in 1801. The page: Belliard surrendered Cairo 27 June 1801, Menou capitulated 2 September 1801 (timeline: 31 August), the army was repatriated in British ships. Trial: the 168 Nile cells are Ottoman from the end of 1801 and stay so in 1802 (published draft: French again in 1802 by the size rule, 168 cell-years).

colonial-brazil_1801 (1801-1815) = Cliopatria Portuguese 1805 inside Brazil (28,147 cells) plus the Misiones Orientales (235). Same page support as events/0; 'neither Spain nor Portugal gave back ... (Eastern Missions)' covers the whole span to 1815. Needed together with events/0: without it the 1801 snap releases the missions. Trial: the colonial-brazil_1801 snap of 226 removed cells disappears.

New keyframe spanish-empire_1800b, 1800 only: the Misiones Orientales (235) and the Dominican Republic (252), 487 cells. The page: 'In January 1801, Louverture and his nephew, General Hyacinthe Moise invaded the Spanish territory, taking possession of it from the governor'; the Misiones were taken in the war of May-June 1801 (War of the Oranges page). Trial: the 1800 Spanish snap now removes 300 cells instead of 768; Spain holds 226 mission cells and 243 Santo Domingo cells at the end of 1800, Haiti takes the east in 1801 (spanish-empire/ledger/72).

New keyframe french-consulate_1802b (1802-1804): the Dominican Republic (252) plus Piedmont and Aosta without Novara (109), 361 cells. Saint-Domingue expedition page: 'Landing at Santo Domingo with 2,000 men, General Kerverseau took possession of a large part of the Spanish area' (February 1802 landings); Captaincy General page: the Era de Francia 'lasted until 1809'; Subalpine Republic page for the six departements of 11 September 1802. Trial: the east is French (252) at the end of 1802 and 1803, Piedmont French (99) from the end of 1802. Side effect: a 243-cell R2 conflict with first-french-empire in 1804 (consulate ends May 1804), harmless.

New keyframe first-french-empire_1804b (1804-1808): the Dominican Republic (252 cells, about 49,000 km2 of land; coast cells inflate the count). Page: Treaty of Basel 22 July 1795 ceded Santo Domingo to France; 'This period called the Era de Francia, lasted until 1809'; infobox 'Santo Domingo returned to Spain: 9 July 1809'. Trial: French 243 (Haiti keeps 9 border cells) 1804-1808, Spanish from July 1809 by spanish-empire/ledger/74-76.

russian-empire_1809 (1809-1810) = Cliopatria 1809 plus the 60 km Ternopil circle (47 cells, about 11,900 km2), the same spec as russian-empire/ledger/51 and kingdom-of-galicia-and-lodomeria/ledger/4. Page: 14 October 1809, Austria ceded 'Tarnopol district to the Russian Empire' (no area given; the circle is the dossiers' own stand-in). Trial: all 47 cells Russian at the end of 1809 (published draft: 32 ownerless).

emirate-of-diriyah wins against habesh-eyalet in the Hejaz (Makkah, Al Madinah, Tabuk: 1,407 cells) 1803-1810. Page: 'Wahhabi forces ... entered Mecca in 1803 after defeating Ghalib and forcing his surrender'; 'the Wahhabis gained control of Mecca and Medina by 1805'; first Ottoman gain 'In 1811 ... landed in Yanbu'. Trial: settles 1,397 cell-years (575 cells in 1803, 822 in 1805); the emirate holds 571 Hejaz cells 1803-1804 and 1,393 from 1805. Minor: the emirate's own 1803 keyframe adds the Medina circle (about 8 cells) a year before its ledger's April 1804; the page's 'by 1805' does not contradict it. Fits p1810-p1819 rulings/3 (1811-1812).

illyrian-provinces wins against habsburg-military-frontier 1809-1813. The page supports only 'the Croatian lands southwest of the river Sava', but the ruling had no region and gave all 55 conflict cells to the provinces, 14 of them north-east of the Sava (Koprivnica-Krizevci, 7 cells at 46.0-46.3 N; Moslavina and Novska, 7 cells), land the treaty did not cede.
checks.fix: Added region: a 10-point polygon whose north-east edge follows the Sava (Slovenian border, Zagreb 15.98/45.79, Sisak 16.37/45.47, Jasenovac 16.91/45.26, Stara Gradiska 17.25/45.15), with a reviewer note in why. Re-ran --check-patch (10 ok) and the trial: the ruling settles 41 cell-years; at the end of 1809 the provinces hold 41 cells and the Military Frontier keeps the 14 north-east of the Sava.

Trial (my stage /tmp/claude-0/work/review-p1800/stage): all 10 applied; rulings/0 settles 1,397 cell-years, rulings/1 41; end anchor p1810: 1,847 cells change owner against the published draft (this includes dossier edits made since).
problems: illyrian-provinces ledger/0 (found, Oct 1809) and keyframes _1809/_1810 ('Croatia minus Slavonia and Dalmatia' with Carniola): they also take 19 cells of Lower Styria (Celje, Maribor, Ptuj; 46.2-46.8 N, 15.1-16.1 E) from duchy-of-styria in 1809 by R1, and they claim Koprivnica-Krizevci and Moslavina north-east of the Sava. The Treaty of Schoenbrunn page lists no Styrian cession. Needs a dossier fix (cut Styria and the land north-east of the Sava from the found region and the keyframes) or, for now, a ruling duchy-of-styria over illyrian-provinces 1809-1813.

Tarnopol beyond the window: russian-empire_1811, _1812 (including the p1810-p1819 override keyframe_overrides/2) and _1814 hold only 15 of the 47 cells of the Ternopil circle. A snap in 1811 can release the other 32 until kingdom-of-galicia-and-lodomeria/ledger/5 returns the district in 1815. The p1810-p1819 agent should add the circle to those keyframes.

Entries that reach into p1810-p1819: rulings/0 (to 1810); rulings/1 (to 1813; now limited to the land south-west of the Sava); keyframe_overrides/0 (the island-only kingdom-of-sardinia_1802 now stands alone to 1813); keyframe_overrides/2 (colonial-brazil_1801 spans 1801-1815); keyframe_overrides/6 (russian-empire_1809 spans 1809-1810).
The window agent's own problems stand unverified by me: the Cis-Sutlej dossier request, overlapping keyframes without 'to' in other dossiers, kingdom-of-tahiti ledger/1 (Moorea) unresolved.
